author: New China TV
description:
On Nov. 2, 20 university students from Oklahoma (USA) visited the unique desert oasis in China's Dunhuang.
A flash mob brought the foreign guests and Chinese performers together. Music and dance carried on the friendship stories along the ancient Silk Road.
title: Music and dance carry on friendship stories along ancient Silk Road in Dunhuang

author: New China TV
description: The 12th Harissa Festival was held in Nabeul, northeastern Tunisia, from Friday to Sunday, and was organized by the local Maintenance Association to promote traditional food culture.
title: Tunisia holds Harissa Festival

author: New China TV
description:
Better weather alerts for Sri Lanka! 🌦
Sri Lanka has officially received a customized MAZU intelligent meteorological early warning terminal during the 11th World Mazu Culture Forum.
The MAZU solution has been deployed in eight countries, including Pakistan and Sri Lanka.
title: MAZU intelligent all-in-one terminal delivered to Sri Lanka

author: New China TV
description:
For decades, protecting and developing China's "mother river" has been a monumental journey. From early flood control to modern ecological revival, how has the Yellow River transformed over the past 80 years?
With AIGC bringing vintage photos to life, take a time-travel journey with us and witness these incredible changes.
title: Then & Now: 80 years of Yellow River management efforts in China

author: New China TV
description:
Instead of taking his 80-year-old grandma to the Great Wall ... he brought the Great Wall to her.
Using local sorghum grains on the ground, this young man in Shanxi, China crafted a stunning masterpiece at his feet, capturing a selfie as if he and his grandma were on the Great Wall!
#Heartwarming #FamilyLove #CreativeArt #AmazingCreativity
title: Chinese man recreates Great Wall from sorghum grains for grandma

author: New China TV
description:
What makes #Zhangjiajie so unforgettable? A group of African journalists and influencers recently visited the "Avatar mountains" in #China's #Hunan Province, where towering peaks and a well-preserved natural environment left a strong impression.
Explore the park through their eyes and hear what impressed them most about the scenery and their experiences along the way. 🌿 #ChinaTravel
title: Trendy China | African journalists, influencers discover beauty of China's Zhangjiajie

title: Xinhua News | Xi stresses improving protection, coordination to make Yellow River more beautiful

author: New China TV
description:
A golden harvest, three generations of trains!
A viral video captured three generations of Chinese trains passing through golden rice paddies in Gula Town, south China's Guangxi. The picturesque scene brings together different eras of China's railway development in one frame.
#China #Railway #HighSpeedRail #Guangxi #ChinaTravel
title: Three generations of Chinese trains share the frame in a golden rice-field scene

author: New China TV
description: Since signing a mutton export protocol in 2023 with China, Madagascar has been opening new commercial opportunities for its goat farmers. In Morondava, herders are expanding their flocks as Chinese demand continues to rise. This year, Malagasy mutton returns to the China International Import Expo for a third time. #GLOBALink #CIIE
title: Malagasy goat farmers expand herds as China demand grows

author: New China TV
description:
A Japanese civil-society delegation visited the Unit 731 exhibition hall and former sites in northeast China's Heilongjiang Province on Oct. 28.
Standing before evidence of the Japanese army's wartime atrocities, delegation members expressed deep remorse and called for the truth of history to be passed on to younger generations.
"Friendship between China and Japan ... must be built on a correct understanding of history," said the delegation's head, Takakage Fujita.
#Unit731 #History #ChinaJapanRelations
title: Japanese delegation reflects on history at former Unit 731 sites in China

description: Chinese President Xi Jinping and Peruvian President Keiko Fujimori on Monday exchanged congratulations on the 55th anniversary of diplomatic relations between the two countries. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | Xi, Peruvian president exchange congratulations on 55th anniversary of ties

description:
Too fast for its human! A robot dog gets ahead of its controller and has to stop and wait at the first World Robot Mount Taishan Climbing Competition in Tai'an, east China's Shandong Province. Looks like someone needs to catch up!
#Robots #RobotDog #MountTai #ChinaTech
title: Robot dog waits for human teammate at climbing contest

author: New China TV
description:
A glowing salute in the night sky!
Around 2,000 drones lit up China's Zhuhai on Sunday, kicking off the 77th anniversary celebrations of the founding of the People's Liberation Army (PLA) Air Force on Nov. 11, 1949. 
The 15 themed displays showcased iconic PLA Air Force aircraft and equipment, as well as advances in its integrated operational capabilities.
#China #Zhuhai #DroneShow #PLAAirForce #Aviation
title: Chinese Air Force anniversary celebrations kick off with 2,000-drone show

author: New China TV
description:
Check in, roll up your sleeves, and get harvesting!
Foreign tourists are swapping sightseeing for hands-on fun at the Longji Rice Terraces in Guilin, south China's Guangxi.
They're experiencing local harvest traditions and even joining in the dancing.
Now that's an autumn getaway with a twist!
#China #Guilin #LongjiRiceTerraces #RiceHarvest #RuralTourism #TravelChina
title: Hands-on holiday: Foreign tourists join rice harvest in China's Guilin

author: New China TV
description: A Chinese exoskeleton helped British stroke survivor Suzanne Elliott walk again at the Canton Fair. The technology moved her to tears and is bringing hope to more families around the world. #CantonFair #exoskeleton #China #technology
title: Chinese exoskeleton moves British stroke survivor to tears at Canton Fair

description:
A truck carrying burning cargo raced straight to a fire station for help in Zhanjiang, China. Firefighters sprang into action and put out the flames within minutes.
No injuries. No serious damage. Just a lightning-fast response! 
#Firefighters #FireRescue #QuickResponse #China
title: Truck with burning cargo rushes to fire station for help
